```{r}
#| label: tbl-rd04-fuel-estimates
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| tbl-cap: >
#|   Companion values for the RD04 fuel inventory (candidate appendix table).
#|   Entries are mean (lower, upper 95% confidence limits), in Mg ha^-1^. GS = group
#|   selection; LD = low-density dispersed retention; HA = high-density
#|   aggregated retention; HD = high-density dispersed retention. Load means
#|   include modeled zeros, integrate over all fitted random intercepts, and
#|   equally weight the four study-site contexts. The signed woody reduction
#|   is pre-PCT minus post-PCT from the joint matched phase model, retaining
#|   pre/post covariance; it is a potential surface-fuel contribution, not
#|   measured slash. Load intervals use the log-scale delta method; reduction
#|   intervals use the response-scale delta method. These are intervals for
#|   means, not prediction intervals. Models remain provisional; intervals
#|   exclude model-selection and component-derivation uncertainty. Post-PCT
#|   litter and duff are not estimated.

fuel_table_source <- read.csv(
  "outputs/fuel/tables/rd04-fuel-model-estimates.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
fuel_table_keys <- c("component", "phase", "treatment")
stopifnot(nrow(fuel_table_source) == 60L,
          !anyDuplicated(fuel_table_source[fuel_table_keys]),
          all(is.finite(as.matrix(fuel_table_source[c("estimate", "lcl", "ucl")]))),
          all(fuel_table_source$lcl <= fuel_table_source$estimate),
          all(fuel_table_source$ucl >= fuel_table_source$estimate))
fuel_table_rows <- unique(fuel_table_source[c("component", "phase")])
stopifnot(nrow(fuel_table_rows) == 15L)
fuel_table <- fuel_table_rows
for (trt in c("gs", "ld", "ha", "hd")) {
  values <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(fuel_table_rows)), function(i) {
    cell <- fuel_table_source[
      fuel_table_source$component == fuel_table_rows$component[i] &
      fuel_table_source$phase == fuel_table_rows$phase[i] &
      fuel_table_source$treatment == trt, ]
    stopifnot(nrow(cell) == 1L)
    sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", cell$estimate, cell$lcl, cell$ucl)
  }, character(1))
  fuel_table[[toupper(trt)]] <- values
}
fuel_table$component <- sub(" (pre-PCT only)", "", fuel_table$component, fixed = TRUE)
fuel_table$component[fuel_table$phase == "Vegetation difference"] <-
  "Woody standing-vegetation reduction"
fuel_table$phase[fuel_table$phase == "Vegetation difference"] <- "Pre minus post"
names(fuel_table)[1:2] <- c("Component", "Phase")
knitr::kable(fuel_table, row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", "l", rep("r", 4)))
```
